summary: Frontend Playwright testing of Dakshinapaaka Menu modal (iteration 2). Tested all 4 bug fixes and 12 luxury features on both 1440x900 desktop and 390x844 mobile. Most features pass: layout stability is rock-solid (0px shift on both viewports across 3 next-page clicks), category chip jumps map correctly to expected pages, autoplay advances and shows the pulsing Slideshow badge, thumbnail navigation works, download fires (dakshinapaaka-juices-evening-specials.png), lightbox opens (yarl__portal), cinematic mode hides the quickjump chips (opacity 0) and shows the exit pill, keyboard shortcuts (Arrow/Space/C/F) work, modal state resets to 01/07 on close+reopen, arrows visible on mobile, and images fill the gold-emerald frame edge-to-edge (screenshots confirm). THREE issues found: (1) Fullscreen button IS present on the 390x844 mobile viewport (spec: must NOT exist on mobile), (2) Escape key does not close the modal on desktop (modal-thumbnail-bar still present after Escape; likely no keydown Escape handler for the modal-close path, or focus isn't inside the modal), (3) When modal is open on mobile, document.documentElement.scrollHeight (7921) > innerHeight (844) - body.overflow is correctly 'hidden' so page cannot actually scroll, but the strict spec assertion fails. Additionally, dev-mode React hydration mismatch warnings appear on initial load (Hero + several className whitespace differences), likely from a build-time className normalizer/tw-merge not applied consistently between SSR and CSR - non-blocking but noisy.

ui_bugs.issue: Fullscreen button is still rendered on 390x844 mobile viewport. Spec requires it to be hidden/absent on mobile (touch device / small screen). getComputedStyle shows display!=none. Needs a `hidden sm:inline-flex` (or useIsTouchDevice() guard) around the button.
Pressing Escape (with modal open, no cinematic, no lightbox) does NOT close the modal. The [data-testid="menu-thumbnail-bar"] remains in DOM after Escape. Users cannot dismiss the modal via keyboard.

document.documentElement.scrollHeight=7921 > innerHeight=844 when modal open on mobile. body.style.overflow='hidden' prevents actual scrolling, so functional impact is limited, but the underlying page still has full height. Consider also setting html { overflow: hidden } or position:fixed on body when modal is open, so scrollHeight assertion matches spec.

issues: Image fills gold-emerald frame edge-to-edge (looks correct). No obvious letterboxing. Chrome layout is stable across next-page clicks.

React hydration mismatch warnings on Home/Hero and many child className props — appears to be whitespace/newline differences between SSR and CSR class strings (likely a template-literal className that resolves differently). Not visible to end users but should be cleaned before prod.

action_items: Hide [data-testid="fullscreen-btn"] on mobile (390px) — add responsive class `hidden md:inline-flex` or gate render behind !isTouchDevice / a min-width media query.

Add Escape-key handler that calls onClose when modal is open (and no lightbox/cinematic is active). Verify the modal container has tabIndex or a document-level keydown listener that isn't unregistered too early.
Optional: when modal is open, also lock html { overflow: hidden } or set body position:fixed so documentElement.scrollHeight <= innerHeight on mobile.

Investigate SSR/CSR className mismatch (looks like a shared `cx()`/template-literal helper producing different whitespace between server and client). Likely a whitespace-normalization difference — trim/replace multi-spaces consistently on both sides.
critical_code_review_comments: MenuModal fullscreen-btn should respect viewport / touch capability. useIsTouchDevice hook exists — use it here.
Escape handling appears incomplete for the modal-close path (works for cinematic exit only).
Body scroll lock uses only body.overflow=hidden; iOS Safari and strict spec require also locking html or using position:fixed technique.
Dev-only: multiple hydration warnings from Hero / FloatingMenuButton className strings — indicates non-deterministic class stringification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Modal features fully instrumented. Detailed pass/fail per feature: layout_stability_desktop=PASS(0px), layout_stability_mobile=PASS(0px), no_scroll_desktop=partial (body overflow hidden but doc.scrollHeight>innerHeight), no_scroll_mobile=partial (same), chips(dosa->04/07, juices->05/07, mains->07/07, breakfast->02/07)=PASS, autoplay=PASS(04->05, badge present), fullscreen_btn_desktop=PASS present, fullscreen_hidden_mobile=FAIL (still present), cinematic=PASS (chip opacity 0, exit pill present; note thumb_op stayed 1 — verify by design if thumbnail bar should also fade), share=clicked ok, download=PASS (file named dakshinapaaka-juices-evening-specials.png), lightbox=PASS (.yarl__portal), keyboard nav Right/Left=PASS, modal_reset=PASS(07/07->01/07), escape_close=FAIL, mobile_arrows_visible=PASS. Cinematic thumbnail bar opacity stayed 1 — worth checking if that is intended (spec said 'chips row AND thumbnail bar become opacity 0').
rca of the issue: 1) Fullscreen button on mobile: likely rendered unconditionally in MenuModal.tsx toolbar. Fix: wrap with `!isTouchDevice && ...` or add `hidden md:inline-flex` tailwind classes. 2) Escape not closing modal: keydown handler likely only handles cinematic exit, not full modal dismiss. Add: if (e.key === 'Escape' && !cinematic && !lightboxOpen) onClose(). 3) Cinematic hides chips but not thumbnail bar — check the opacity animation target in MenuModal.tsx cinematic branch.
